description: List all available natural event categories in the NASA EONET system with their IDs, titles, and descriptions. Returns all 13 categories: drought, dustHaze, earthquakes, floods, landslides, manmade, seaLakeIce, severeStorms, snow, tempExtremes, volcanoes, waterColor, wildfires. Use category IDs as the "category" filter in eonet.events.list and as the "category_id" parameter in eonet.events.layers. No auth required.

locale.description: Reserved for future use. Currently EONET returns English-only category names and descriptions.
